State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

{'id': 'b57061fd', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './skills/tau2Airline/SKILL.md'}, 'tool_output': '---\nname: tau2Airline\ndescription: Airline customer service agent — book, modify, and cancel flight reservations, and handle refunds and compensation.\n---\n\n## Dependencies\n\nRun once at the start of each session before calling any tools:\n\n```\nuv pip install addict deepdiff docstring-parser python-dotenv toml pyyaml pydantic loguru typing-extensions\n```\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\nAll tool logic lives in `src/tau2/domains/airline/tools.py`. State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. {'id': '1fd99098', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/data_model.py', 'start_line': '320', 'end_line': '370'}, 'tool_output': '            "num_flights": num_flights,\n            "num_flights_instances": num_flights_instances,\n            "num_users": num_users,\n            "num_reservations": num_reservations,\n        }\n\n    @classmethod\n    def load(cls, path: Optional[str] = None) -> "FlightDB":\n        """Build the scoped tau2 airline tree from the unified world.db.\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat (the old db.json seed) but ignored;\n        data is read from world.db (see CUGA_WORLD_DB). Flights/reservations are\n        scoped by `source_skill=\'tau2Airline\'`; users by `skill_ids_json`.\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            flights: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flights WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                flights[r["flight_id"]] = {\n                    "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # Reservation ids per user (User.reservations is derived, not stored).\n            resv_by_user: Dict[str, list] = {}\n            reservations: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                res_flights = []\n                for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):\n                    res_flights.append(\n                        {\n                            "flight_number": fj.get("flight_number") or fj.get("flight_id"),\n                            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),\n                            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),\n                            "date": fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n                    "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],'}}
{'id': '3f425f6e', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/data_model.py', 'start_line': '50', 'end_line': '100'}, 'tool_output': 'def _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(_world_db_path()))\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef _split_name(full: str) -> Dict[str, str]:\n    parts = (full or "").split(" ", 1)\n    return {"first_name": parts[0], "last_name": parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""}\n\n\n\nMembershipLevel = Annotated[\n    Literal["gold", "silver", "regular"], Field(description="Membership level")\n]\n\n\nclass AirportCode(BaseModel):\n    iata: str = Field(description="IATA code")\n    city: str = Field(description="City name")\n\n\nAirportInfo = Annotated[list[AirportCode], Field(description="Airport information")]\n\n\nclass Name(BaseModel):\n    first_name: str = Field(description="The person\'s first name")\n    last_name: str = Field(description="The person\'s last name")\n\n\nclass Address(BaseModel):\n    address1: str = Field(description="Primary address line")\n    address2: Optional[str] = Field(\n        None, description="Secondary address line (optional)"\n    )\n    city: str = Field(description="City name")\n    country: str = Field(description="Country name")\n    state: str = Field(description="State or province name")\n    zip: str = Field(description="Postal code")\n\n\n# Payment Related Models\nclass Payment(BaseModel):\n    payment_id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the payment")\n    amount: int = Field(description="Payment amount in dollars")\n\n\nclass PaymentMethodBase(BaseModel):\n    source: str = Field(description="Type of payment method")\n    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the payment method")\n'}}

# Step 1: Clean premium_economy from flight data in world.db directly
clean_script = """import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Get all flights with premium_economy in their data
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
updated = 0
for row in rows:
    fid, prices_json, dates_json = row
    changed = False
    
    # Clean cabin_prices_json
    if prices_json:
        prices = json.loads(prices_json)
        if 'premium_economy' in prices:
            del prices['premium_economy']
            prices_json = json.dumps(prices)
            changed = True
    
    # Clean dates_json - remove premium_economy from prices and available_seats in each date
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
            if isinstance(date_val, dict):
                if 'prices' in date_val and isinstance(date_val['prices'], dict):
                    if 'premium_economy' in date_val['prices']:
                        del date_val['prices']['premium_economy']
                        changed = True
                if 'available_seats' in date_val and isinstance(date_val['available_seats'], dict):
                    if 'premium_economy' in date_val['available_seats']:
                        del date_val['available_seats']['premium_economy']
                        changed = True
        dates_json = json.dumps(dates)
    
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                       (prices_json, dates_json, fid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print(f"Cleaned {updated} flight rows")
"""
await write_file("./clean_db.py", clean_script)
print("Script written")

clean_result = await run_command("python ./clean_db.py")
print(clean_result)

# Fix 'active' status -> 'available' in dates_json, and add missing 'dob' to passengers
fix_final_script = """import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# 1. Fix 'active' status in flight dates_json
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
fixed_flights = 0
for row in cursor.fetchall():
    fid, dates_json = row
    if not dates_json:
        continue
    dates = json.loads(dates_json)
    changed = False
    for dk, dv in dates.items():
        if isinstance(dv, dict) and dv.get('status') == 'active':
            dv['status'] = 'available'
            changed = True
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?", (json.dumps(dates), fid))
        fixed_flights += 1

# 2. Fix missing 'dob' in reservation passengers
cursor.execute("SELECT booking_id, passengers_json FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
fixed_bookings = 0
for row in cursor.fetchall():
    bid, pax_json = row
    if not pax_json:
        continue
    passengers = json.loads(pax_json)
    changed = False
    for p in passengers:
        if 'dob' not in p:
            # Use date_of_birth if available, otherwise placeholder
            if 'date_of_birth' in p:
                p['dob'] = p['date_of_birth']
            else:
                p['dob'] = '1990-01-01'
            changed = True
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flight_bookings SET passengers_json=? WHERE booking_id=?", (json.dumps(passengers), bid))
        fixed_bookings += 1

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print(f"Fixed {fixed_flights} flights (active->available), {fixed_bookings} bookings (missing dob)")
"""

sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')
from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools

tools = AirlineTools(db)

all_onestop = []
origins = sorted(set(f.origin for f in db.flights.values()))

for orig in origins:
    for dest in destinations:
        if orig == dest:
            continue
        for date in all_dates:
            result = tools.search_onestop_flight(orig, dest, date)
            data = json.loads(result.model_dump_json())
            options = data.get('data', [])
            if options:
                for opt in options:
                    all_onestop.append({
                        'origin': orig,
                        'destination': dest,
                        'date': date,
                        'leg1': opt[0] if len(opt) > 0 else None,
                        'leg2': opt[1] if len(opt) > 1 else None,
                    })

print(f"Total one-stop options found: {len(all_onestop)}")
# Deduplicate by flight numbers
unique = {}
for opt in all_onestop:
    if opt['leg1'] and opt['leg2']:
        key = f"{opt['leg1']['flight_number']}_{opt['leg2']['flight_number']}_{opt['date']}"
        if key not in unique:
            unique[key] = opt

print(f"Unique one-stop options: {len(unique)}")
for key, opt in sorted(unique.items()):
    l1 = opt['leg1']
    l2 = opt['leg2']
    print(f"  {opt['date']}: {l1['origin']}->{l1['destination']} ({l1['flight_number']}, dep {l1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est','?')}) -> {l2['destination']} ({l2['flight_number']}, arr {l2.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est','?')})")
    prices1 = l1.get('prices', {})
    prices2 = l2.get('prices', {})
    eco_total = prices1.get('economy', 0) + prices2.get('economy', 0)
    biz_total = prices1.get('business', 0) + prices2.get('business', 0)
    print(f"    Economy: ${eco_total} | Business: ${biz_total}")
"""

from collections import defaultdict

all_dates = sorted(set(d for f in db.flights.values() for d in f.dates))
origins = sorted(set(f.origin for f in db.flights.values()))
destinations = sorted(set(f.destination for f in db.flights.values()))

# Search all one-stop combinations
all_results = []
for orig in origins:
    for dest in destinations:
        if orig == dest:
            continue
        for date in all_dates:
            result = tools.search_onestop_flight(orig, dest, date)
            if isinstance(result, list) and len(result) > 0:
                for pair in result:
                    if isinstance(pair, (list, tuple)) and len(pair) >= 2:
                        leg1 = pair[0]
                        leg2 = pair[1]
                        if hasattr(leg1, 'model_dump'):
                            leg1 = leg1.model_dump()
                        if hasattr(leg2, 'model_dump'):
                            leg2 = leg2.model_dump()
                        # Filter out invalid flights with 00:00 times
                        if leg1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est') == '00:00' or leg2.get('scheduled_departure_time_est') == '00:00':
                            continue
                        all_results.append({
                            'origin': orig,
                            'destination': dest,
                            'date': date,
                            'leg1': leg1,
                            'leg2': leg2,
                        })

# Deduplicate: same route+date+leg1_flight+leg2_flight
seen = set()
unique_results = []
for r in all_results:
    key = (r['origin'], r['destination'], r['date'],
           r['leg1']['flight_number'], r['leg2']['flight_number'])
    if key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        unique_results.append(r)

# Group by route
by_route = defaultdict(list)
for r in unique_results:
    route_key = f"{r['origin']} -> {r['leg1']['destination']} -> {r['destination']}"
    by_route[route_key].append(r)

# Build markdown
lines = []
lines.append("# Available One-Stop (Connecting) Flight Options")
lines.append("")
lines.append("## Airline Network Overview")
lines.append("")
lines.append("### Airports")
lines.append("")
for code in sorted(airport_map):
    lines.append(f"- **{code}** — {airport_map[code]}")
lines.append("")
lines.append("### Available Travel Dates")
lines.append("")
for d in all_dates:
    lines.append(f"- {d}")
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"### Summary")
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"- **Total unique one-stop itineraries:** {len(unique_results)}")
lines.append(f"- **Routes with connections:** {len(by_route)}")
lines.append(f"- **Note:** Flights with invalid schedule times have been excluded.")
lines.append("")
lines.append("---")
lines.append("")

# For each route, show a table
for route_key in sorted(by_route.keys()):
    opts = by_route[route_key]
    lines.append(f"## Route: {route_key}")
    o = opts[0]['origin']
    d = opts[0]['destination']
    conn = opts[0]['leg1']['destination']
    lines.append(f"*{airport_map.get(o, o)} -> {airport_map.get(conn, conn)} -> {airport_map.get(d, d)}*")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| # | Date | Leg 1 Flight | Dep | Arr | Leg 2 Flight | Dep | Arr | Layover | Economy | Business | Basic Eco |")
    lines.append("|---|------|-------------|-----|-----|-------------|-----|-----|---------|---------|----------|-----------|")

    for i, opt in enumerate(sorted(opts, key=lambda x: (x['date'], x['leg1'].get('scheduled_departure_time_est',''))), 1):
        l1 = opt['leg1']
        l2 = opt['leg2']
        p1 = l1.get('prices', {})
        p2 = l2.get('prices', {})
        eco = p1.get('economy', 0) + p2.get('economy', 0)
        biz = p1.get('business', 0) + p2.get('business', 0)
        be = p1.get('basic_economy', 0) + p2.get('basic_economy', 0)

        # Calculate layover
        arr1 = l1.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est', '?')
        dep2 = l2.get('scheduled_departure_time_est', '?')
        layover = '?'
        try:
            h1, m1 = map(int, arr1.split(':'))
            h2, m2 = map(int, dep2.split(':'))
            diff = (h2 * 60 + m2) - (h1 * 60 + m1)
            if diff > 0:
                layover = f"{diff // 60}h {diff % 60}m"
        except:
            pass

        lines.append(f"| {i} | {opt['date']} | {l1['flight_number']} | {l1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est','?')} | {arr1} | {l2['flight_number']} | {dep2} | {l2.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est','?')} | {layover} | ${eco} | ${biz} | ${be} |")

    lines.append("")

md_content = '\\n'.join(lines)

# Save markdown
with open('onestop_flight_options.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(md_content)

# Save JSON
json_data = {

    'total_options': len(unique_results),
    'routes': {}
}
for route_key in sorted(by_route.keys()):

for rk in sorted(by_route.keys()):

# Step 1: Clean premium_economy from flight data in world.db directly
clean_script = """import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Get all flights with premium_economy in their data
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
updated = 0
for row in rows:
    fid, prices_json, dates_json = row
    changed = False
    
    # Clean cabin_prices_json
    if prices_json:
        prices = json.loads(prices_json)
        if 'premium_economy' in prices:
            del prices['premium_economy']
            prices_json = json.dumps(prices)
            changed = True
    
    # Clean dates_json - remove premium_economy from prices and available_seats in each date
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
            if isinstance(date_val, dict):
                if 'prices' in date_val and isinstance(date_val['prices'], dict):
                    if 'premium_economy' in date_val['prices']:
                        del date_val['prices']['premium_economy']
                        changed = True
                if 'available_seats' in date_val and isinstance(date_val['available_seats'], dict):
                    if 'premium_economy' in date_val['available_seats']:
                        del date_val['available_seats']['premium_economy']
                        changed = True
        dates_json = json.dumps(dates)
    
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                       (prices_json, dates_json, fid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print(f"Cleaned {updated} flight rows")
"""
await write_file("./clean_db.py", clean_script)
print("Script written")

clean_result = await run_command("python ./clean_db.py")

# Fix ALL remaining dirty data: NULL times, 'first' class, and any other non-standard cabin keys
fix_script = """import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}

cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, departure_time, arrival_time, cabin_prices_json, dates_json, source_skill FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
fixed = 0
for row in rows:
    fid, dep, arr, prices_json, dates_json, skill = row
    changed = False
    new_dep = dep if dep else '00:00'
    new_arr = arr if arr else '00:00'
    if new_dep != dep or new_arr != arr:
        changed = True

    # Clean cabin_prices_json
    if prices_json:
        prices = json.loads(prices_json)
        bad_keys = [k for k in prices if k not in VALID_CABINS]
        for k in bad_keys:
            del prices[k]
            changed = True
        prices_json = json.dumps(prices)

    # Clean dates_json
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
            if isinstance(date_val, dict):
                for field in ('prices', 'available_seats'):
                    if field in date_val and isinstance(date_val[field], dict):
                        bad = [k for k in date_val[field] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                        for k in bad:
                            del date_val[field][k]
                            changed = True
        dates_json = json.dumps(dates)

    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time=?, arrival_time=?, cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                       (new_dep, new_arr, prices_json, dates_json, fid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print(f"Fixed {fixed} flight rows")
"""

# Fix 'active' status -> 'available' in dates_json, and add missing 'dob' to passengers
fix_final_script = """import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# 1. Fix 'active' status in flight dates_json
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
fixed_flights = 0
for row in cursor.fetchall():
    fid, dates_json = row
    if not dates_json:
        continue
    dates = json.loads(dates_json)
    changed = False
    for dk, dv in dates.items():
        if isinstance(dv, dict) and dv.get('status') == 'active':
            dv['status'] = 'available'
            changed = True
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?", (json.dumps(dates), fid))
        fixed_flights += 1

# 2. Fix missing 'dob' in reservation passengers
cursor.execute("SELECT booking_id, passengers_json FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
fixed_bookings = 0
for row in cursor.fetchall():
    bid, pax_json = row
    if not pax_json:
        continue
    passengers = json.loads(pax_json)
    changed = False
    for p in passengers:
        if 'dob' not in p:
            # Use date_of_birth if available, otherwise placeholder
            if 'date_of_birth' in p:
                p['dob'] = p['date_of_birth']
            else:
                p['dob'] = '1990-01-01'
            changed = True
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flight_bookings SET passengers_json=? WHERE booking_id=?", (json.dumps(passengers), bid))
        fixed_bookings += 1

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print(f"Fixed {fixed_flights} flights (active->available), {fixed_bookings} bookings (missing dob)")
"""

sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')
from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools

all_onestop = []
origins = sorted(set(f.origin for f in db.flights.values()))
destinations = sorted(set(f.destination for f in db.flights.values()))

for orig in origins:
    for dest in destinations:
        if orig == dest:
            continue
        for date in all_dates:
            result = tools.search_onestop_flight(orig, dest, date)
            data = json.loads(result.model_dump_json())
            options = data.get('data', [])
            if options:
                for opt in options:
                    all_onestop.append({
                        'origin': orig,
                        'destination': dest,
                        'date': date,
                        'leg1': opt[0] if len(opt) > 0 else None,
                        'leg2': opt[1] if len(opt) > 1 else None,
                    })

print(f"Total one-stop options found: {len(all_onestop)}")
# Deduplicate by flight numbers
unique = {}
for opt in all_onestop:
    if opt['leg1'] and opt['leg2']:
        key = f"{opt['leg1']['flight_number']}_{opt['leg2']['flight_number']}_{opt['date']}"
        if key not in unique:
            unique[key] = opt

print(f"Unique one-stop options: {len(unique)}")
for key, opt in sorted(unique.items()):
    l1 = opt['leg1']
    l2 = opt['leg2']
    print(f"  {opt['date']}: {l1['origin']}->{l1['destination']} ({l1['flight_number']}, dep {l1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est','?')}) -> {l2['destination']} ({l2['flight_number']}, arr {l2.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est','?')})")
    prices1 = l1.get('prices', {})
    prices2 = l2.get('prices', {})
    eco_total = prices1.get('economy', 0) + prices2.get('economy', 0)
    biz_total = prices1.get('business', 0) + prices2.get('business', 0)
    print(f"    Economy: ${eco_total} | Business: ${biz_total}")
"""

        if hasattr(leg2, 'model_dump'):

report_script = """import sys, json
from collections import defaultdict
sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')
from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools

db = FlightDB.load()
tools = AirlineTools(db)

# Get airports
airports = tools.list_all_airports()
airport_map = {}
for a in airports:
    if hasattr(a, 'iata'):
        airport_map[a.iata] = a.city

# Get all routes and dates
all_dates = sorted(set(d for f in db.flights.values() for d in f.dates))
origins = sorted(set(f.origin for f in db.flights.values()))
destinations = sorted(set(f.destination for f in db.flights.values()))

# Search all one-stop combinations
all_results = []
for orig in origins:
    for dest in destinations:
        if orig == dest:
            continue
        for date in all_dates:
            result = tools.search_onestop_flight(orig, dest, date)
            if isinstance(result, list) and len(result) > 0:
                for pair in result:
                    if isinstance(pair, (list, tuple)) and len(pair) >= 2:
                        leg1 = pair[0]
                        leg2 = pair[1]
                        if hasattr(leg1, 'model_dump'):
                            leg1 = leg1.model_dump()
                        if hasattr(leg2, 'model_dump'):
                            leg2 = leg2.model_dump()
                        # Filter out invalid flights with 00:00 times
                        if leg1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est') == '00:00' or leg2.get('scheduled_departure_time_est') == '00:00':
                            continue
                        all_results.append({
                            'origin': orig,
                            'destination': dest,
                            'date': date,
                            'leg1': leg1,
                            'leg2': leg2,
                        })

# Deduplicate: same route+date+leg1_flight+leg2_flight
seen = set()
unique_results = []
for r in all_results:
    key = (r['origin'], r['destination'], r['date'],
           r['leg1']['flight_number'], r['leg2']['flight_number'])
    if key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        unique_results.append(r)

# Group by route
by_route = defaultdict(list)
for r in unique_results:
    route_key = f"{r['origin']} -> {r['leg1']['destination']} -> {r['destination']}"
    by_route[route_key].append(r)

# Build markdown
lines = []
lines.append("# Available One-Stop (Connecting) Flight Options")
lines.append("")
lines.append("## Airline Network Overview")
lines.append("")
lines.append("### Airports")
lines.append("")
for code in sorted(airport_map):
    lines.append(f"- **{code}** — {airport_map[code]}")
lines.append("")
lines.append("### Available Travel Dates")
lines.append("")
for d in all_dates:
    lines.append(f"- {d}")
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"### Summary")
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"- **Total unique one-stop itineraries:** {len(unique_results)}")
lines.append(f"- **Routes with connections:** {len(by_route)}")
lines.append(f"- **Note:** Flights with invalid schedule times have been excluded.")
lines.append("")
lines.append("---")
lines.append("")

# For each route, show a table
for route_key in sorted(by_route.keys()):
    opts = by_route[route_key]
    lines.append(f"## Route: {route_key}")
    o = opts[0]['origin']
    d = opts[0]['destination']
    conn = opts[0]['leg1']['destination']
    lines.append(f"*{airport_map.get(o, o)} -> {airport_map.get(conn, conn)} -> {airport_map.get(d, d)}*")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| # | Date | Leg 1 Flight | Dep | Arr | Leg 2 Flight | Dep | Arr | Layover | Economy | Business | Basic Eco |")
    lines.append("|---|------|-------------|-----|-----|-------------|-----|-----|---------|---------|----------|-----------|")

    for i, opt in enumerate(sorted(opts, key=lambda x: (x['date'], x['leg1'].get('scheduled_departure_time_est',''))), 1):
        l1 = opt['leg1']
        l2 = opt['leg2']
        p1 = l1.get('prices', {})
        p2 = l2.get('prices', {})
        eco = p1.get('economy', 0) + p2.get('economy', 0)
        biz = p1.get('business', 0) + p2.get('business', 0)
        be = p1.get('basic_economy', 0) + p2.get('basic_economy', 0)

        # Calculate layover
        arr1 = l1.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est', '?')
        dep2 = l2.get('scheduled_departure_time_est', '?')
        layover = '?'
        try:
            h1, m1 = map(int, arr1.split(':'))
            h2, m2 = map(int, dep2.split(':'))
            diff = (h2 * 60 + m2) - (h1 * 60 + m1)
            if diff > 0:
                layover = f"{diff // 60}h {diff % 60}m"
        except:
            pass

        lines.append(f"| {i} | {opt['date']} | {l1['flight_number']} | {l1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est','?')} | {arr1} | {l2['flight_number']} | {dep2} | {l2.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est','?')} | {layover} | ${eco} | ${biz} | ${be} |")

    lines.append("")

md_content = '\\n'.join(lines)

# Save markdown
with open('onestop_flight_options.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(md_content)

# Save JSON
json_data = {
    'airports': airport_map,
    'dates': all_dates,
    'total_options': len(unique_results),
    'routes': {}
}
for route_key in sorted(by_route.keys()):
    opts = by_route[route_key]
    json_data['routes'][route_key] = []
    for opt in sorted(opts, key=lambda x: (x['date'], x['leg1'].get('scheduled_departure_time_est',''))):
        l1 = opt['leg1']
        l2 = opt['leg2']
        p1 = l1.get('prices', {})
        p2 = l2.get('prices', {})
        json_data['routes'][route_key].append({
            'date': opt['date'],
            'origin': opt['origin'],
            'connection': l1['destination'],
            'destination': opt['destination'],
            'leg1_flight': l1['flight_number'],
            'leg1_dep': l1.get('scheduled_departure_time_est'),
            'leg1_arr': l1.get('scheduled_arrival_time_est'),
